name: Uttarakhand State Data Centre (ITDA / SDC-ITDA)
developer: Information Technology Development Agency (ITDA), Government of Uttarakhand
notes: Official Uttarakhand IT service listing identifies SDC-ITDA in Dehradun and says ITDA has set up the State Data Centre for G2G/G2C/G2B e-services. Schneider Electric case study says Uttarakhand State Data Center was built for state e-governance, supports Dehradun Smart City applications, and achieved about 99.99% uptime. Capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: CtrlS Uttarakhand Rated-4 Edge Data Center
notes: CtrlS signed an MoU with the Uttarakhand government to invest Rs 250 crore in a greenfield edge data center planned for delivery over 8-10 years; reported capacity is 10 MW and services include colocation, managed services, and cloud. Exact district/site was not disclosed in the public sources; assigned to Dehradun for batch coverage because the agreement is state-level and Dehradun is the state capital/current data-center hub.

name: STPI Dehradun High Speed Data Centre
developer: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) / Government of Uttarakhand
notes: STPI Dehradun official about page search result states STPI set up the first High Speed Data Centre of the state. Page fetch returned a transient 502 during this run, so details and capacity could not be verified beyond the indexed official snippet.
